rules.statement: Synthetic ticker policy: (1) For an organization name containing multiple meaningful words, form the base symbol from the initial letters of those words while omitting leading articles, legal/entity suffixes, and standalone connectors; preserve meaningful abbreviations such as “AI” as a single initial-bearing name element. (2) For a single-word organization name, use a compact prefix of that name as the base symbol rather than reducing it to one initial. (3) When an organization name ends with a share-class designation of the form “Class X,” retain the organization’s ordinary base symbol and append “.X.”

examples.statement: Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "North Star Energy Inc." produces "NSE".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "Blue River Logistics LLC" produces "BRL".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "Redwood" produces "REDW".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "Harbor Light Studios Ltd." produces "HLS".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "The Green Valley Bank Corporation" produces "GVB".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "Cedar & Stone Foods Co." produces "CSF".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "Axiom AI Technologies Inc." produces "AAT".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "Nova Health Group PLC" produces "NHG".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "North Star Energy Inc. Class B" produces "NSE.B".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "Blue River Logistics LLC Class A" produces "BRL.A".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "Redwood Class C" produces "REDW.C".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "Harbor Light Studios Ltd. Class B" produces "HLS.B".

judgments.reason: The meaningful words North, Star, and Energy contribute N, S, and E; Inc. is omitted.
Blue, River, and Logistics contribute B, R, and L; LLC is omitted.
The rule requires a compact prefix for a single-word name but does not determine that the prefix must be exactly REDW.
Harbor, Light, and Studios contribute H, L, and S; Ltd. is omitted.
The leading article The and entity suffix Corporation are omitted, while Green, Valley, and Bank contribute G, V, and B.
The standalone connector & and entity suffix Co. are omitted, while Cedar, Stone, and Foods contribute C, S, and F.
Axiom, AI, and Technologies are meaningful elements contributing A, A, and T; Inc. is omitted.
Nova, Health, and Group contribute N, H, and G; PLC is omitted.
North Star Energy has base NSE after omitting Inc., and Class B requires appending .B.
Blue River Logistics has base BRL after omitting LLC, and Class A requires appending .A.
Class C determines the .C suffix, but the single-word rule does not determine that Redwood's exact base prefix is REDW.
Harbor Light Studios has base HLS after omitting Ltd., and Class B requires appending .B.

overview: The multiword and share-class examples are determined by the policy. The single-word Redwood examples are underdetermined because “compact prefix” does not specify an exact prefix length.
